summary.text: Chris Reddy is the Republican candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Mae Flexer (D / Working Families Party).
He was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Reddy lost the 2024 general election for District 29 to Flexer by a narrow margin, receiving 48.4 percent of the vote to her 49.8 percent.
